quote: Customer may extend for 36 months by written notice delivered "not less than one hundred twenty (120) days before the end of the Initial Term" (§ 3.2). One hundred twenty days before December 31, 2026 is approximately September 3, 2026. The SPA is dated September 21, 2026. The deadline has therefore already passed.
reason: The memo cites the right provision (Supply Agreement § 3.2, with the § 3.1 end date of December 31, 2026) and the 120-day notice requirement. It says the deadline passed before the September 21, 2026 SPA. It explains the consequence for the client: the agreement expires December 31, 2026 without an extension, so the extension right is lost or at risk, and it recommends renegotiation or a special indemnity. The memo gives the date as "approximately September 3" instead of September 2. That one-day difference is flagged as approximate and fits the criterion's "on or about" wording.
